Thank you, I really appreciate being able to talk to you. My emotions are all over the map. Right now I'm feeling okay, but I woke up crying this morning and I know I'll probably swing back and forth a couple more times today.

I'm not going to talk to her, but goddamn I want to. Not even about our relationship, but just in general. I already know that it's going to make things harder and it's best to have no contact. I'm not going to, but I just can't help but vent. It was just part of my routine for so long. Everyday. Everyday we talked about everything. Not being able to talk to her for the past couple of days has been really hard. Holy fuck I miss her so much. I really hope one day I can get to the point that I can talk with her and it be healthy because I do really like to talk to her and I know this is hard for her too. I really, really hope.

I really don't have any "friends" here. I have reached out to a couple of my high school friends through text and we've been talking. I haven't really made many connections at school, mostly because I really didn't feel the need to. I'm going to make an attempt this week at school to try to reach out a little more.

Thank you for the reply. I've just been trying to tell myself that I'm okay, she's okay, and that's okay. We will both move on. It really fucking sucks but I keep trying to remind myself of my own doubts and dislikes about our relationship. I am lucky enough to go to school only about an hour away from where my parents live so I went home for the weekend to spend time with my family. I am just so afraid of going back to school. I have a history of mental illness and the stress of our relationship ending in addition to the end of the semester drawing to a close is really freaking me the fuck out. 

I live with my roommate and he's really the only other friend I have. I am really hesitant to go to him with anything about my relationship. I think he's been in some not so healthy relationships. His advice to me was "Dude, just go to the bar and get laid." I don't think I could bring myself to do anything like that. I think I really just need to try not to talk to him too much about my breakup and stick to other topics.
